title: Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A hearty and flavorful dish inspired by traditional Syrian cuisine, featuring tender lamb kebabs grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground lamb, olive oil, onion, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Thread lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through to an internal temperature of 145°F.
Warm pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it on the grill for a few minutes.
Assemble kebabs by placing cooked meat on pita bread and serving immediately.
